Magical Explorer: Reborn as a Side Character in a Fantasy Dating Sim
Magical Explorer: Reincarnated as an Eroge Hero's Friend, I'll Live Freely With My Eroge Knowledge.
meta.description: Few titles are more revered among horndogs-(ahem) connoisseurs of Japanese erotic video games-than Magical Explorer. One day, our smut-loving hero wakes up to find he has been reincarnated into the body of the game’s dreamboat protagonist! Or rather, his hapless comic-relief best friend, Kousuke Takioto. But with his unparalleled knowledge of Magical Explorer and Kousuke’s unorthodox abilities (a scarf that doubles as a fist?), our hero vows to turn the game’s unluckiest loser into its mightiest heartthrob. In this world, nothing is out of reach when you’ve got the know-how!

videos.title: Reincarnated as a Sidekick Character in an Eroge, but I’ll Use My Game Knowledge to Do What I Want
videos.overview: Takioto Kousuke is reincarnated into his favorite eroge, Magical Explorer, but as the unlucky sidekick?!

videos.title: Greetings From the Land of the Elves
videos.overview: Kousuke barely saves Ludie from an attack by the Church of the Malevolent God, so he vows to get stronger.

videos.title: Staples of Any Eroge
videos.overview: Kousuke asks Mizumori Yukine to train him so he can learn the Mind's Eye skill.

videos.title: Determination
videos.overview: In order to get stronger faster, Kousuke enters the solo dungeon "Twilight Cavern" to find Nanami.

videos.title: Greetings, Tsukuyomi Magic Academy
videos.overview: Kousuke and Iori are late on their first day at Tsukuyomi Magic Academy and Kousuke ends up in a mock battle?!

videos.title: Stormy Skies! Carplin Castle
videos.overview: Kousuke's team is so strong that they have to go for a special dungeons called the Carplin Castle.

videos.title: And, From Here
videos.overview: Kousuke and Nanami go to the Night Sky Cave to acquire a new skill, but they find a weird, extra floor?

videos.title: That's A Pink Bomb
videos.overview: Kousuke gets caught by Ruija-sensei and is forced to participate in a weird experiment...
